scope: Existing native executable, original firmware, unthrottled headless, no sound device; read-only MAME -log diagnostics. Current working source has pre-existing edits and is not asserted identical to this executable.
interpretation: 647 overruns occur after a byte is latched with mask 0x11 (MIDI source6 disabled), before that byte is consumed. Subsequent receive logs show mask 0x54 and post-load playback/release passes. Existing disk acceptance measures host scheduling and recovery, not lossless guest reception. Read totals are not unique receive counts: initialization reads and checkpoint replay also read the port.
limits: No physical IC4 measurement, proven FIFO depth, exact concurrent-source priority or fix. The log does not timestamp each dropped byte or record its current mask. The latched-byte mask must not be represented as a separate mask measurement for every overrun.

reproduction.method: Harness appends -log to native MAME Popen, then runs existing verify_native_disk_midi.py or verify_native_runtime.py --polyphony in fresh private state directories. It does not modify guest state or serial timing.
